title: L.L. Bean Recalls Children’s Sweaters Due to Choking Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The spare button attached to the label on the inside seam of the sweaters can detach, posing a choking hazard. Units: 5300.

title: Lea Industries Recalls Lighted Night Stands Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The light fixture under the night stand can overheat and scorch carpet, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 500 in the United States and 20 in Canada.

title: VIZIO Recalls to Repair 39- and 42-Inch E-Series Flat Panel Televisions Due to Risk of Tip Over
summary: The stand assembly can fail and cause the television to tip over unexpectedly, posing a risk of impact injury to the consumer. Units: About 245,000.

title: Johnson Outdoors Diving Recalls Dive Computers Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The dive computer can leak and stop working, posing a risk of injury due to decompression sickness. Units: About 350 and about 40 in Canada.

title: Samson International Recalls Bar Stool Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Costco
summary: The footrest can crack, compromising the strength of the bar stool, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 800.

title: PetSmart Recalls Top Fin Plastic Aquarium Heaters Due to Electrical Shock Hazard
summary: The heaters are insufficiently grounded, posing a risk of electrical shock to the consumer. Units: About 33,000.

title: Two Deaths Reported with Ace Bayou Bean Bag Chairs; Recall Announced Due to Suffocation and Choking Hazards
summary: The zippers on the bean bag chairs can be opened by children who can then crawl inside, get trapped and suffocate or choke on the bean bag chair's foam beads. Units: About 2.2 million.

title: SolarWorld Recalls Solar Systems with Copper Grounding Lugs Due to Electrocution, Electric Shock or Fire Hazard
summary: SolarWorld solar panels installed with bare-copper grounding lugs can corrode which could result in a faulty ground circuit, posing an electric shock, electrocution or fire hazard. Units: About 1.3 million in the U.S. and 210,000 in Canada.

title: WilliamsRDM Recalls StoveTop FireStop Microhood Due to Safety Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The Microhood front canister can fall from the unit and fail to suppress the fire. Units: About 103,000.

title: Attwood Recalls Kayak and Watersports Storage Hanger Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The length adjustment buckles release unexpectedly, causing the item being stored to fall and injure people nearby Units: 10000.

title: Bexco Recalls Franklin & Ben Mason 4-in-1 Convertible Cribs Due to Fall and Entrapment Hazards
summary: The crib front can separate from the side panels and create a hazardous gap that can allow a child to fall out or become entrapped between the front and side panels. Units: About 1,000 in the U.S and 100 in Canada.

title: BRITA Recalls Children’s Water Bottles Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The lid can break into pieces with sharp points, posing a laceration hazard Units: About 242,500.

title: Golden Artist Colors Recalls QoR Synthetic Ox Gall due to Skin Irritation (Recall Alert)
summary: Risk of skin rash or blistering Units: About 470 units and 90 in Canada.

title: Snowmobiles Recalled by Arctic Cat Due to Fuel Leak and Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Fuel can leak from the fuel line assembly, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3,260.

title: Vornado Air Recalls Electric Space Heaters Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The heater can overheat and cause the units to melt, catch fire and ignite nearby items, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 79,000.

title: ESL, Interlogix Hard-Wired Smoke Alarms Recalled Due to Failure to Alert Consumers of a Fire
summary: Radio frequency interference can cause the smoke detectors to fail to alert consumers of a fire. Units: About 141,000 in U.S. and 13,000 in Canada.

title: CoScentrix Recalls Candles in Metal Tins Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Hobby Lobby
summary: The candle's high flame can ignite the surface of the wax and the polymer coating on the tin-plated container, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 126,000.

title: JPC Equestrian Recalls Stirrup Leathers Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The stirrup leather can crack and break, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Units: About 1,200.

title: American Woodcrafters Recalls Bunk Beds Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Havertys (Recall Alert)
summary: The bed's side mattress support rails can break, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 1,900.

title: Goodman Company Recalls Air Conditioning and Heating Units Due to Burn and Fire Hazards
summary: The power cords on the air conditioning and heating units can overheat, posing burn and fire hazards. Units: About 233,500.

title: Multi-Purpose Outdoor Shelters Recalled By Sunjoy Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at BJ's Wholesale Club (Recall Alert)
summary: The fabric canopy on the shelters fails to comply with a voluntary flammability standard, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,000.

title: NRS Recalls Water Sports Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury
summary: The rivets holding the chin strap to the helmet can fail and cause the helmet to fall off in an incident, posing a risk of head injury. Units: About 3,300.

title: Swimwear Anywhere Recalls Little Marc Jacobs Girls Hooded Jackets Due to Strangulation Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The jackets have a drawstring around the neck area which poses a strangulation hazard to children. Drawstrings can become entangled or caught on playground slides, hand rails, school bus doors or other moving objects, posing a significant strangulation and/or entanglement hazard to children. Units:

title: Cree Recalls LED Light Fixtures Due to Laceration Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The glass lens on the fixture can break, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 10,000.

title: Hewlett-Packard Recalls Notebook Computer AC Power Cords Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The AC power cord can overheat, posing a potential fire and burn hazard. Units: 5,577,000 in the U.S. and 446,700 in Canada.
